title: Delivery Delay Duration
scenario: Calculate the average delay (customer_pref_delivery_date - order_date) for scheduled orders. Return the result as 'avg_delay_days'.
tableSchema: delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE)
hint: Filter for scheduled orders where date difference is > 0.
correctQuery: SELECT AVG(customer_pref_delivery_date - order_date) AS avg_delay_days FROM delivery WHERE customer_pref_delivery_date > order_date;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE); INSERT INTO delivery VALUES (1, 1, '2019-08-01', '2019-08-02');
